item.title: Op Sagar Bandhu: Indian Army builds third Bailey bridge in Sri Lanka after cyclone
item.description: New Delhi: The Indian Army has successfully constructed a third Bailey bridge on Sri Lanka’s B-492 Highway, linking Kandy and Nuwara Eliya in the Central Province, restoring a critical lifeline that was severed for over a month following Cyclone Ditwah. item.description: Mohali: Singer B Praak has reportedly received a death threat from a person claiming to be linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, with the caller allegedly demanding Rs 10 crore and warning of serious consequences if the demand is not met, officials said Saturday. item.title: 4.1-magnitude quake strikes Kutch’s Khawda area, no damage reported
item.description: Kutch: Just days ahead of the anniversary of the devastating 7.6-magnitude 2001 Gujarat earthquake, a 4.1 magnitude tremor struck Khawda in Gujarat’s Kutch district early Saturday, triggering panic among residents in several areas According to officials, the epicentre of the earthquake was located around 55 km from Khawda, and the tremor was recorded at 1:22 […]
